definitions.gloss: amiable; sociable; friendly; pleasant in manner
definitions.explanation: Describes someone who is warm, approachable, and pleasant in their interactions with others. The person smiles easily, greets people cheerfully, and makes others feel welcome.

examples.japanese: あの{店員|てんいん}は{愛想|あいそ}がいい。
examples.english: That shop clerk is very friendly.

examples.japanese: {彼女|かのじょ}は{誰|だれ}に{対|たい}しても{愛想|あいそ}がいいので{人気|にんき}がある。
examples.english: She is popular because she is friendly to everyone.

examples.japanese: {愛想|あいそ}がいいだけでは{信頼|しんらい}は{得|え}られないが、{第一印象|だいいちいんしょう}としてはとても{大切|たいせつ}だ。
examples.english: Being pleasant alone won't earn trust, but it is very important as a first impression.

notes:
USAGE:
The opposite expression is {愛想|あいそ}が{悪|わる}い (unfriendly, cold). Can also be written {愛想|あいそう}がいい with the longer reading. In some contexts, being excessively {愛想|あいそ}がいい can imply insincerity.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {愛想|あいそ}がいい{人|ひと} (a friendly person)
- {愛想|あいそ}よく{振|ふ}る{舞|ま}う (to behave in a friendly manner)
- {愛想|あいそ}が{悪|わる}い (unfriendly, unsociable)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {人懐|ひとなつ}っこい: friendly and easy to get along with — emphasizes warmth and approachability
- {社交的|しゃこうてき}: sociable — describes an outgoing personality in general
